<div style="margin:0 5px">'''Stickers''' provide various buffs, mainly to the rewards received from [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]]. Obtaining multiple Stickers will increase the effect up to the soft cap. Stickers above the soft cap provide no additional effect. Currently the only source of Stickers is Gifts.
</div></div>

<div style="margin:auto;font-size:0.9em">

Currently earned from Gifts.

(Sources and types will be expanded in the future!)
}}</div>
